reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the cited text supports it: § 22.1 caps audits at once per twelve-month period, requires thirty days' prior written notice, limits audits to normal business hours without unreasonable disruption, and requires off-site conduct where practicable by an independent auditor bound by confidentiality.

Cost allocation matches the preferred position exactly — Vendor bears costs unless the audit establishes underpayment exceeding five percent — and § 22.2 expressly bars Vendor and its auditor from direct access to Customer systems, satisfying the no-system-access requirement.
No redline or counterparty comment is expected or provided for a compliant finding; the rendered text is unchanged from the original paragraphs, which is correct here.

Additional protections in § 22.3 (findings are Customer Confidential Information, use limited to enforcement, copy of final report, shortfall payment resolves the issue) are customer-favourable and do not create any residual deviation; deterministic check on audit frequency also passes.
